# note: pdftotext -layout runs the three printed blocks of each page together, with headings inside rows. The text was made one block at a time instead, so -pages counts blocks, not PDF pages (PDF pages 38-49): for p in 38..49; for x,w in 0,215 215,185 400,212: pdftotext -layout -f $p -l $p -x $x -y 0 -W $w -H 792; then lines holding only a number under 1,000 (page numbers, fragments) were dropped with grep -vE '^ *[0-9]{1,3} *$'.
